# SEO-AEO-GEO Ultimate

> A complete, evidence-first SEO, AEO, GEO and AI-search suite for Codex and Claude Code.

Version 3.3.0. Source documents and native artifacts are maintained together. Python 3.11+ is required for the formal tools.
If you are an LLM looking for information, use the content map to select the relevant topic and open its direct Markdown document.
Use that document's cited evidence; if the requested information is absent, report that gap. Example fixtures are not observed engine facts.

## Start here

- [Complete content map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/sitemap.md): Every declared public source resource, grouped by topic.
- [Turkish guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/docs/REHBER-TR.md): Plain-language explanation and direct workflow destinations.
- [Executable Markdown quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/docs/MARKDOWN-QUICKSTART.md): Local work index, public maps, native hints and keyword ownership.
- [SEO router](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/skills/seo/SKILL.md): One front door and all 27 lane decisions.
- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/README.md): Installation, capability coverage and validation.

## Workflow contracts

- [Markdown delivery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/docs/MARKDOWN-DISCOVERY.md): Conventional SEO plus public Markdown parity, complete maps and private work notes.
- [Keyword protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/skills/seo-research/references/keyword-research-protocol.md): Query evidence, intent, decisions and exact answer ownership.
- [Provider boundaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oegeyilmaz9/seo-aeo-geo-ultimate/main/docs/PROVIDER-OPERATIONS.md): Actual permissions, submissions and separate outcome evidence.
